profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Guild
profile.summary: As a creative Front End Engineer, I value using both my left and right brain. My technical skills help me solve challenging problems and write efficient code, while my creative side encourages me to develop clean and unique user interfaces.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: Built new features and maintained the e-commerce side of the web application. Designed and implemented new internal tools to support the content side of the product. User flow build-outs including search, shop galleries, checkout, pricing, coupons, payments, subscriptions, account management, and dynamic site messaging. Integrated analytics to track user's interaction within the platform. Incorporated A/B testing to measure new feature performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description: Planned, built, tested, and delivered a custom CMS web application marketed towards media buying solutions. Built highly performant and scalable software systems. Led a team of engineers by managing projects, deadlines, and deliverables. Discussed, researched, tested, and implemented UX/UI best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built numerous client facing systems with a wide range of technologies. Communicated closely with designers and product owners on how to streamline internal workflows. Collaborated with the CTO on defining best practices and technologies to use within the engineering team.

positions.title: Lead Campus Instructor
positions.description: Girls Who Code is a national nonprofit organization that exposes young girls to computer science in order to close the gender gap in the tech industry. Taught high school girls the fundamentals of computer science, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

volunteerExperiences.description: Tutored college level Calculus I, Calculus II, Calculus III, Linear Algebra, and Complex Variables
